subject: Add-ons billing path and residency/HSM options for WellBridge

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Clarification on billing paths for compliance add-ons (HSM / residency / audit logs)

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — your team did a great job walking us through the residency and audit log capabilities. Before we move to a formal PO, procurement has a few open questions about how Redwood wants to bill the compliance add-ons so we can align with our internal CAPEX/OPEX rules. Can you confirm the following and share any supporting SOW/line-item detail?

1) HSM/KMS: do you offer (a) per-seat HSM licensing or (b) usage-metered HSM operations billing? If both, please provide the price points and whether seats can be swapped between regions.
2) Residency & Audit Logs: is residency billed as a one-time implementation fee + monthly maintenance, or as a committed monthly surcharge? We're trying to understand amortization for our budget team.
3) Discounts/credits: for a 24-month committed contract and an initial commit of ~2B tokens/month, what is the discount/playbook for the compliance bundle (audit logs + residency + HSM)? Any onboarding credits?
4) Can you share an itemized SOW or sample invoice format so our AP team can map line items to GL codes?

Attached an outline of the SOW items we expect (WellBridge_SOW_Request.xlsx). Happy to hop on a short call — procurement is aiming to finalize terms by end of month.

Best,
Marta Cole
Procurement Manager, WellBridge Health
[Attachment: WellBridge_SOW_Request.xlsx (xlsx)]
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Marta Cole <marta.cole@wellbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Aug 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarification on billing paths for compliance add-ons (HSM / residency / audit logs)

Marta — thanks for the clear list, appreciated. I pulled together initial options below to align with your finance constraints; Ben and Laura are cc'd to confirm pricing and SOW detail.

Short answers up front: we can support both seat-based and usage-based HSM billing; residency can be structured either as (A) one-time implementation + lower monthly maintenance or (B) higher committed monthly surcharge. We typically amortize large implementation fees when customers prefer monthly OPEX.

Suggested options (high level):
- HSM: Option 1 — Seat model: $12,000/seat/month, includes 24/7 support and maintenance; seats are region-pinned but can be reallocated with 30 days notice.
- HSM: Option 2 — Usage model: $0.10 per 1,000 HSM ops (metered), plus a $2,000/month support line item.
- Residency/audit logs: (A) One-time implementation fee $75,000 + $6,000/month maintenance OR (B) Committed residency surcharge $9,500/month (includes audit log retention 12 months). We can amortize the $75k over 24 months on request.

Discount framework: for a 24-month contract + 2B tokens/month commit we can offer: base 15% discount on add-on list prices, plus a one-time onboarding credit of up to $30k applied to the implementation fee if the contract is signed within 30 days. Ben — is that feasible to present as a first-pass commercial?

Next steps: 15–20 minute call to confirm preferred billing pathway and whether WellBridge wants seats or usage for HSM. I can share a draft itemized SOW and a sample invoice after Ben confirms the numbers. When are you available?

Thanks,
Tessa
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference, Inc.
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Aug 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarification on billing paths for compliance add-ons (HSM / residency / audit logs)

Tessa / Laura — internal pricing note for the WellBridge thread.

Rationale / tradeoffs: seats give predictable recurring revenue and are simpler for customers who require dedicated HSM instances per region; usage avoids upfront seat costs but increases variability. Residency is most defensible as: one-time implementation + monthly ops for customers that prefer CAPEX (we can amortize internally for their P&L).

Concrete proposal to share with WellBridge (conservative):
- HSM seat: $11,000/seat/month (reduce to $10,000 if they commit 2+ seats + 24-month term).
- HSM usage: $0.095 per 1,000 ops with $1,500/month support baseline.
- Residency: $60,000 one-time implementation + $5,500/month maintenance (12-month audit log retention). We can offer to amortize the $60k over 24 months on the invoice at customer's request.
- Bundle discount: 18% off add-on list prices if they take HSM seat + residency + audit-logs together with a 24-month core commit. If they sign within 14 days, increase to 20% and apply $40k onboarding credit against the implementation fee (must be consumed in first invoice).

Attachments: pricing_workback.xlsx (shows math for seat vs usage and amortization examples).

Approval: Tessa — I suggest sharing the conservative proposal above with Marta and flagging the 20%/40k early-signing concession as time-limited. Laura — pls confirm contract language for amortizing the implementation fee (we can add a payment schedule).

Thanks,
Ben
Director, Commercial Operations
[Attachment: pricing_workback.xlsx (xlsx)]

Marta — thanks for the patience. Based on internal review here's the formalized proposal and next steps. I've attached a brief PDF summary (WB_Proposal_v1.pdf) that maps line items to what your AP/finance asked for.

Proposal summary (final):
- HSM seat: $11,000/seat/month; or HSM usage at $0.095/1k ops + $1,500/month support baseline. Seats are region-pinned but can be reallocated with 30 days notice.
- Residency & audit logs: $60,000 one-time implementation (can be amortized over 24 months on the invoice) + $5,500/month maintenance (12-month retention included).
- Bundle discount: 18% off add-on list prices for a 24-month deal with your 2B tokens/month commit. Early-sign bonus: sign within 14 days and we increase to 20% + apply a $40,000 onboarding credit to the implementation fee.

What we need from you to proceed:
1) Confirmation of billing preference (seat vs usage for HSM)
2) PO or formal acceptance of the terms above (we can work via DocuSign or PO + SOW)
3) Any special GL mapping required for invoice line-item names (we included a sample mapping in the attached PDF).

If that sounds good, I can have legal issue a SOW + amendment reflecting amortization schedule and the onboarding credit. Happy to do a 20-minute alignment call; I have availability Monday 8/23 10:00-11:30am PT or Tuesday 8/24 2:00-4:00pm PT.

Best regards,
Tessa Morgan
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0143
